name: Alarm box
summary: The group writes a tune on a drawn music box: tap the brass drum to set pins in your colour on a grid of 16 steps by 8 notes, crank it and the drum turns for everyone, pins pluck the comb and little notes float up, and when it sounds right the group sets it as the friend's next alarm.
useWhen: let's write calvin a new alarm he can't sleep through
make a little song together in the chat
music box where we each add notes
dontUseWhen: picking songs for a playlist (use sound-crate)
waking someone up with a game (use seven-alarms)
a real reminder at a time (use reminder)

sub.description: Line under the title, e.g. 'a tune he can't sleep through'

owner.description: Whose alarm or tune it becomes

pins.description: Pins friends already set: name, step 1 to 16, note 1 (low) to 8 (high); up to 12 each

said.description: Up to 4 lines from friends about the tune so far
